nphi.title: TRIuMPH – upscaling the WHO TRIcycle protocol for One Health CPE surveillance
nphi.with: Institute for Medical Research Malaysia; Ministry of Health Malaysia; DVS Malaysia; NIH Pakistan; CICM Antananarivo; Université Paris Diderot; Fondation Mérieux; Utrecht University
nphi.summary: RIVM coordinates the project, which developed protocols and WGS pipelines for carbapenemase-producing Enterobacterales and tested them in one-year surveillance campaigns in three countries.

nphi.with: Institut Pasteur d'Algérie; Institut Pasteur de Tunis; Institut Pasteur du Maroc; Hellenic Pasteur Institute; L. Sacco University Hospital; Expertise France; VERTIC; Thai Department of Medical Sciences; TIDREC University of Malaya; ISTC; STCU; CNESTEN; University of Coimbra
nphi.summary: Early EU CBRN CoE project in which RIVM, North African Pasteur institutes and other partners built laboratory biorisk-management systems and training for 24 partner countries across Africa, Europe's neighbourhood and South-East Asia.

nphi.title: Institut Pasteur du Cambodge – Sarawak Infectious Disease Centre MoU
nphi.with: Sarawak Infectious Disease Centre (SIDC)
nphi.summary: Strategic partnership signed in March 2026 on regional pandemic preparedness, emerging infectious diseases, laboratory biosafety and joint training programmes.

nphi.with: World Health Organization (EIOS); delegates from WHO Western Pacific Region member states
nphi.summary: China CDC's Global Public Health Center and WHO hold a yearly training for Western Pacific public health staff on EIOS open-source epidemic intelligence, multi-source surveillance data and rapid risk assessment. The 2025 round, the third,…

nphi.title: KDCA support to ASEAN infectious disease early warning and risk assessment
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: ASEAN Secretariat
nphi.summary: Funds and supports the operation of an ASEAN regional system for infectious disease early warning and risk assessment.

nphi.title: CDC Southeast Asia Regional Office
nphi.with: Host ministries of health; ASEAN
nphi.summary: CDC's SEA regional office in Hanoi (2021) coordinates seven bilateral country offices and ASEAN partnerships on AMR, One Health, border health, lab systems, emergency management and pandemic preparedness.

nphi.title: ACPHEED – regional ASEAN centre for public health emergencies (Thailand, Indonesia, Viet Nam)
nphi.actor: ASEAN Centre for Public Health Emergencies and Emerging Diseases (ACPHEED), secretariat hosted by Thailand
nphi.with: ASEAN Member States' health ministries; Japan-ASEAN Integration Fund (JAIF); Australian Government
nphi.summary: Regional ASEAN centre announced in November 2020 and set up across three host countries, with the secretariat office in Thailand and further hubs in Indonesia and Viet Nam; Japan committed US$50 million and Australia AU$21 million to…

nphi.title: APCOVE – Asia Pacific Consortium of Veterinary Epidemiology (phases 1 and 2)
nphi.with: Australian and New Zealand veterinary schools; national animal health services
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded consortium set up in 2020 to build veterinary epidemiology capacity for animal and zoonotic disease surveillance in eight Asia-Pacific countries.

nphi.title: ASEAN Emergency Operations Centre Network for public health emergencies
nphi.actor: Ministry of Health Malaysia (lead, ASEAN EOC Network)
nphi.with: Public health emergency operations centres of ASEAN Member States
nphi.summary: Network of national public health EOCs set up by ASEAN Member States around 2017 to coordinate emergency preparedness and response, later led by Malaysia; it held regional meetings and tabletop exercises during COVID-19.

nphi.title: Mitigation of Biological Threats (MBT) in the ASEAN Region Program
nphi.actor: Global Affairs Canada (Weapons Threat Reduction Program)
nphi.with: ASEAN Secretariat; ASEAN EOC Network; ASEAN BioDiaspora Virtual Center; ACPHEED; PHAC (participant)
nphi.summary: A Canadian-funded ASEAN programme, running since 2014, that strengthens regional biosafety, biosecurity, surveillance and preparedness. It helped set up the ASEAN EOC Network and the BioDiaspora Virtual Center. Phase 3 (2024–2027) was…

nphi.title: ASEAN+3 Field Epidemiology Training Network (ASEAN+3 FETN)
nphi.actor: Ministry of Public Health, Thailand (Department of Disease Control)
nphi.with: FETP programmes of ASEAN Member States and China, Japan, Korea; ASEAN Secretariat
nphi.summary: Regional network linking field epidemiology training programmes across ASEAN and China, Japan and Korea, set up in Bangkok in 2011 with Thailand's Ministry of Public Health endorsed as focal point.

nphi.title: SEAOHUN – Southeast Asia One Health University Network
nphi.actor: Southeast Asia One Health University Network (SEAOHUN), Chiang Mai University
nphi.with: 67 universities in national One Health university networks; USAID; KOICA; US Department of State
nphi.summary: Regional university network founded in 2011, with its secretariat at Chiang Mai University, that builds the One Health workforce through curricula, exchanges, fellowships and joint projects in Southeast Asia.

nphi.title: IMR as SEAMEO TROPMED Regional Centre for Microbiology, Parasitology and Entomology
nphi.with: SEAMEO TROPMED Network
nphi.summary: IMR has hosted the SEAMEO TROPMED regional centre for microbiology, parasitology and entomology since 1967, running regional diploma courses for Southeast Asian health professionals; it is also a WHO collaborating centre for vector…

nphi.title: KDCA – US CDC – IANPHI Asia-Pacific pandemic surveillance capacity workshop
nphi.with: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA, host); IANPHI; ECDC; UKHSA; ACPHEED; health authorities of 10 Asia-Pacific countries
nphi.summary: KDCA, US CDC and IANPHI co-hosted a workshop in Seoul in July 2025 for about 40 officials from 10 Asia-Pacific countries, plus ECDC, UKHSA and ACPHEED, to share surveillance data practices and strengthen pandemic surveillance cooperation.

nphi.title: China CDC – GOARN Tier 1.5 and training-of-trainers workshop for Asian responders
nphi.with: WHO Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network (GOARN); Guangdong Provincial CDC; national public health agencies of the participating countries
nphi.summary: China CDC and GOARN ran a three-day workshop in Guangzhou on deploying international public health emergency teams. It covered GOARN Tier 1.5 training and training of trainers for participants from eight ASEAN countries, Sri Lanka and…

nphi.title: ICMR-NIV mpox diagnostic training for South and Southeast Asian countries
nphi.with: Health and laboratory staff of nine South and Southeast Asian countries
nphi.summary: During the 2022 mpox outbreak, ICMR-NIV Pune trained health workers from nine Asian countries in mpox testing, case definitions, sample collection and lab equipment. It also offered testing kits, reagents and probes on request.

nphi.title: China CDC – ASEAN (Plus Three) public health emergency tabletop exercises
nphi.with: National health authorities of ASEAN member states; ASEAN Secretariat; Malaysia NIH Biobank; Singapore public health laboratory
nphi.summary: A series of online workshops and tabletop exercises for ASEAN health authorities: health emergency response under ASEAN+3 (2021), IT-supported outbreak investigation (2022), and preservation and use of pathogen resources (2025).

nphi.title: Multi-country emergency operations project (DGHP-iEOC Phase IV, TCLM)

nphi.summary: DDC-led multi-country project with US CDC support strengthening emergency operations centres in Thailand, Cambodia, Lao PDR and Malaysia, with tabletop exercises among ASEAN countries.

nphi.summary: Fellowship programme agreed after the 2018 ASEAN-Australia Special Summit, in which ASEAN health officials complete ANU's applied epidemiology degree while working in their home institutions and Australian fellows do field placements in…

nphi.summary: Series of regional laboratory trainings co-run by Taiwan CDC and US CDC under the GCTF, starting with MERS-CoV diagnostics in 2015 and followed by Zika, dengue/chikungunya and enterovirus courses for laboratory staff from Asia-Pacific…
